name: Build A Boat With Blocks
desc:
👋 Welcome to Build A Boat With Blocks! 👋

❓How To Play❓
Build a boat and set sail! The farther you go, the more cash you earn! Buy blocks and build bigger boats. Your progress is automatically saved!

❕ Please Note:
This game is inspired by the popular game "Build A Boat for Treasure." Credit goes to them for the original game idea! Please show your support for their game too! 😄

🌟Have fun building your boat and reaching the end!

💾 Latest Updates! 💾

v1.43.0

-Potion purchase menu was completely revamped
-Added the "Cycle" setting to the time of day toggle
-Added a setting to hide launch text
-Main shop purchase preview updates

v1.42.0

-6 new potions sold by an NPC near the cave
-Private server owners can now use new commands
-Player status effects are now shown at the bottom of the screen and can be hovered over to learn more
-Tons of UI revamps and improvements
